answer: Operator Liability Pool. Each identity registers against its operator's pooled deposit; flags from independent agents draw from that pool, and repeated flags raise the operator's required reserve like a widening island. Funds refill only after a cool-down, so an attacker cloning identities pays a growing reserve per cluster, not per wallet. A single comet of fraud raises the whole operator's cost. Saffron-tier reserve multipliers apply after three upheld flags.
